To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) Leptin, a 167 amino acid protein, is produced and secreted from adipocytes in proportion to the amount of fat in the body and acts as a negative feedback signal in the regulation of body weight.

(1) Leptin is the signal that regulates body weight and is the link between nutrition and physiology, (2) The set-point for leptin is determined in part by the amount of adipose tissue and is a major determinant of weight, and (3) Leptin and its receptor are key components of the system that regulates body weight.
1. The leptin system is a key component of the physiologic system regulating energy balance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the role of leptin in the regulation of body weight and energy balance.
understanding the role of leptin in the regulation of food intake and body weight.
the function of leptin, the regulation of its production, and the role of leptin in the pathogenesis of obesity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the function of leptin is to maintain energy balance.
the function of leptin is to maintain a state of relative energy balance and in doing so, it acts to maintain a state that is optimal for health and well-being.
Leptin is a key component of the system that regulates body weight and that this system is a major determinant of the physiologic response to changes in nutrition.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
leptin is a critical link in the integration of nutrition and physiology.
the leptin system functions to regulate the amount of body fat, and the amount of fat regulates the amount of leptin produced.
leptin has a major role as a mediator of the physiologic response to weight change, and that leptin is a critical component of the physiogic system regulating body weight.
The main takeaway from our work is that
leptin is a hormone produced by fat cells.
leptin is a key link between energy balance and physiology.
the body has a very sophisticated system to maintain a constant weight.
